name: babysit-pr
description: Monitor a pull request or merge request, fix scoped CI failures and review feedback, and prepare it for merge. Supports GitHub (gh) and GitLab (glab).

interface.shortDescription: Fix CI and review blockers until a PR is merge-ready
interface.longDescription: Monitors a GitHub pull request or GitLab merge request, diagnoses failing CI and actionable review feedback, pushes scoped fixes, verifies readiness, and merges only when explicitly authorized.
defaultPrompt: Use $babysit-pr to monitor this PR, fix CI failures and actionable review feedback, and prepare it for merge; merge only when explicitly authorized.
